name: MMIS_PROVLOC_DIM_SK
comment:
Surrogate(system-generated) Key that uniquely identifies a row within the Service Location Dimension.

As a Type 2 Slowly Changing Dimension - there can be multiple rows in the dimension that represent different versions of the same Service Location.

The Service Location Dim SK is the key that identifies each distinct version.  Only one version for each Service Location will be tagged as Current.

name: DE_LOAD_EVENT_ID
comment: Data Ecosystem Load Process Event  Identifier for when the row was originally created

name: DE_LOAD_TS
comment: Data Ecosystem Load Timestamp - identifies when this row was created within the Data Ecosystem

name: DE_UPDT_EVENT_ID
comment: Data Ecosystem  Process Event  Identifier for when the row was most recently updated.

name: DE_UPDT_TS
comment: Data Ecosystem Load Timestamp - identifies when this row was created within the Data Ecosystem

name: DE_ROW_HD
comment:
Data Ecosystem Hash Difference Value: A hash of the columns within a row that can be compared to the current instance of the row to determine if the contents have changed.
When the Hash VERSION is different a new row is required(new VERSION) if only the Hash DIFF changes - than and Update (SCD type 1) is in order.

name: DE_VERSION_HD
comment:
Data Ecosystem Version Hash Difference Value: A hash of the columns within a row that can be compared to the current instance of the row to determine if a new version of a dimension is warranted(Type 2).
When the Hash VERSION is different a new row is required(new VERSION) if only the Hash DIFF changes - than and Update (SCD type 1) is in order.

name: DE_DELETE_IND

name: DE_ROW_END_DT

name: NPI_ID
comment:
National Provider Identifier.

The NPI is a unique identification number for covered health care providers. Covered health care providers and all health plans and health care clearinghouses must use the NPIs in the administrative and financial transactions adopted under HIPAA.
The NPI is a 10-position, intelligence-free numeric identifier (10-digit number). This means that the numbers do not carry other information about healthcare providers, such as the state in which they live or their medical specialty. The NPI must be used in lieu of legacy provider identifiers in the HIPAA standards transactions.
***cms.gov

name: PROVIDER_BUSINESS_NM
comment: The providers name that is commonly used by the public when the "doing-business-as" name is different than the legal name. DBA is an abbreviation for "doing business as." Registering a DBA is required to operate a business under a name that differs from the companys legal name.  If DBA name is the same as the legal name, do not populate DBA name.
